findings.claim: Original camera to terrain footprint uses world camera/far corners, height admission, all-nonpositive far-corner ground intersection, bias-rounded extrema and expanded power-of-two root.
findings.limitations: Finite measured M06 camera states and default CW037F only. Original view remains input; explicit terrain quality and independent authenticated height data required. Supplied Linux/OS/backing and Ghidra services, not native retail Windows/frame/raster. One known emulator boundary discrepancy; arbitrary state, overflow, exceptional FP, repeated rejected frames and full rendering unverified.
